narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.07 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 853.91-853.92 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 866.86; the first objective pays 1.26R at 849.31.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 853.91-853.92
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 866.86 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.26 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 35/100 — trend broken, ask-wall ceiling
